name: Pasadena Convention Center
details: Red Cross-managed evacuation shelter. Meals, cots, emotional support services, Wi-Fi. Pasadena Humane on-site for small pet boarding. Service animals allowed inside.

name: Altadena Community Center
details: Emergency shelter at 2125 N Windsor Ave, Altadena 91001. Beds, food, water, basic medical triage available.

name: Pasadena Civic Auditorium Annex
details: Overflow evacuation site at 1570 E Colorado Blvd, Pasadena 91106. Cots, blankets, meals provided by Red Cross volunteers.

name: Altadena Disaster Recovery Center
details: 540 W Woodbury Rd, Altadena 91001. FEMA and local agency staff on-site. Open daily 9am-8pm. Case management, housing referrals, crisis counseling.

name: Pasadena Humane Society Emergency Shelter
details: 361 S Raymond Ave, Pasadena 91103. Pet-friendly shelter — accepts evacuees with animals. Kennels, pet food, and veterinary triage available.

name: Santa Anita Park Evacuation Site
details: 285 W Huntington Dr, Arcadia 91007. Large animal and equine evacuation site. Also accepting displaced residents. Red Cross on-site.

name: Pasadena Dial-A-Ride
details: Curb-to-curb shared transport for seniors 60+ and disabled residents. Serves Pasadena, Altadena, San Marino. Schedule 24hrs in advance. Mon-Fri 7am-8:30pm, Sat 9am-6:30pm, Sun 7am-6:30pm.

name: Access Services Paratransit — Altadena
details: ADA paratransit serving Altadena and surrounding areas. Wheelchair accessible vehicles. Reservation required. Serves certified riders with disabilities.

name: LA County Emergency Evacuation Buses
details: LA County OES coordinated bus fleet for mass evacuation. Wheelchair lifts on all vehicles. Staging near Eaton Canyon. Activated during mandatory evacuation orders.

name: Red Cross Emergency Response Vehicles
details: Mobile fleet staged at Pasadena Convention Center. Delivers meals, supplies, and provides transport to shelters for displaced residents.

name: MedCare Non-Emergency Medical Transport
details: Non-emergency medical transportation serving Greater LA including Pasadena. Stretcher, wheelchair, and ambulatory transport. Available 24/7.

name: Huntington Hospital Emergency Department
details: 100 W California Blvd, Pasadena 91105. Level II trauma center — only one in San Gabriel Valley. 24/7 emergency room. Cedars-Sinai affiliate.

name: Kaiser Permanente Pasadena Medical Offices & Pharmacy
details: 3280 E Foothill Blvd, Pasadena 91107. Pharmacy, lab, urgent care. Mon-Fri 8am-9pm, Sat-Sun 8am-4pm. Prescription refills and emergency medication access.

name: Altadena Disaster Medical Station
details: Co-located at Altadena Disaster Recovery Center, 540 W Woodbury Rd. Basic first aid, prescription replacement assistance, mental health crisis counseling. LA County DHS staffed.

name: Red Cross Health Services — Convention Center
details: On-site at Pasadena Convention Center shelter. Nurses, EMTs, mental health volunteers. First aid, medication management, chronic disease support (insulin, dialysis referrals).
